title: CYBRIK model-class capability descriptor v1
description: Provider-neutral descriptor of a POLICY-SELECTABLE model class in the model registry (ADR-0002 G3/G4). It advertises what a class can do WITHOUT naming a vendor, product, endpoint, or weights id: those are adapter metadata resolved server-side. Fail-closed: a class with no advertised token/context limits is not registrable; tool/function-calling is explicitly disabled at this seam (a model gets no tool authority). Callers negotiate features against supported_features; an unsupported requested feature is denied, never silently ignored. Status: PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED (v0.1.0).

contract_version.description: Version of THIS capability descriptor for the class (SemVer; ADR-0001). A change that reduces limits or removes a supported feature is a major change.

modalities.description: Vendor-neutral I/O modalities the class accepts/produces.

limits.description: Hard token/context ceilings for the class. A request's limits are clamped to these; the platform never exceeds them.

supported_features.description: Advertised, vendor-neutral feature tokens. A request may only ask for features in this set (fail-closed negotiation). Tool/function-calling is NOT expressible here — it lives in the separate tool_calling field, fixed to 'disabled'.

tool_calling.description: Fixed const 'disabled'. This inference seam grants a model NO tool/function/agent/MCP authority; tool execution is governed by the separate accepted Tool-Fabric packet (ADR-0004), never here. Encoded as a const so no class can advertise tool authority through the inference contract.

structured_output.description: Whether the class can enforce constrained/structured decoding for output_contract. 'enforced' = schema-guaranteed; 'best_effort' = attempts but may fail a strict output_contract (which then errors); 'unsupported' = a strict output_contract is rejected.

data_residency.description: Where the class runs relative to the tenant boundary. 'local' = on-prem/air-gap capable (Ollama/vLLM/llama.cpp per ADR-0002 G3); 'external' = a class that may egress to an external provider (permitted only when data_marking/redaction_policy allow it — enforced control-side).

default_health.description: Health assumed when no fresh health signal is available. Fail-closed guidance: a registry SHOULD set this to 'unavailable' so a class is not routed to on stale signals.
